title: Results & Experience
pedagogicalStatus: Unreviewed draft: formative practice only; CEFR mastery disabled.

sources.title: Virtual pendulum assignment progress (reading; practice)
paragraphs: Maya is preparing a short assignment about a virtual pendulum. She has watched the introduction and has completed the first table. She has already drawn the position-time graph, but she has not written the conclusion yet. Yesterday, she watched the introduction at 4 p.m. She plans to write the conclusion after checking the labels on her graph. Her message reports progress on a simulation assignment, not results from a physical experiment.

sources.title: Physics problem-set checklist (reading; practice)
paragraphs: On Wednesday, Karim worked on a physics problem set. He solved questions 1 and 2 in the afternoon. Today, he has checked both answers and has just corrected a unit in question 2. He has not started question 3 yet. The instructions ask students to show the numerical value and its unit. Karim has completed two questions, but the full assignment is not finished.

sources.title: Virtual circuit report update (reading; practice)
paragraphs: The student team has finished the circuit simulation and has saved its voltage-current table. Nora has already checked the column headings. The group has not added the graph caption yet. On Monday, they ran the simulation for the first time. Today, they have made a clearer table. Their progress note is about a model, not a real electrical circuit.

sources.title: Office-hour study plan (reading; practice)
paragraphs: Samir has read the chapter about waves, but he has not finished the practice questions yet. He has already made a list of new words, including frequency, amplitude and period. His tutor asked him on Tuesday to describe one graph in English. He has just recorded a one-minute explanation. The tutor has not reviewed the recording yet. The message does not claim that Samir has passed a speaking test.
